data_contracts.name: MTF-2 role feature / directional label preregistration
data_contracts.mutability: Frozen V1 preregistration; semantic changes require a new contract_id/version before experiments
legal_writes: Governed MTF-2 contract transaction only; executable source must match by regression test
data_contracts.retention: Git history + feature-schema hash + exact candidate/data lineage
invariants: M5 remains canonical value authority and H4/H1/M15 remain deterministic M5-derived views.
M15 owns SELL/SKIP/BUY direction; M5 closed context cannot flip direction or resurrect SKIP.
V1 uses compact finite-window market features, not naive 4 x CP32 duplication or recursive EMA/ADX/RSI dependencies.

Legacy max_hold_bars without explicit timeframe/bar_minutes is illegal as a label or purge horizon.

support_windows.atr14_sma: mean(last 14 true_range values); exact dependency includes prior close => 15 source bars
support_windows.atr50_sma: mean(last 50 true_range values); exact dependency includes prior close => 51 source bars

directional_label.future_path_authority: canonical M5 bars strictly unavailable to directional features and used only after decision_time for label/evaluation
directional_label.entry_reference: open of the canonical M5 bar whose open_time_utc equals decision_time; missing exact bar => invalid label
directional_label.horizon_rule: horizon_minutes must be positive and divisible by 5; max_hold_bars is accepted only when explicit bar_minutes/timeframe lineage is also supplied; max_hold_bars alone fails closed
directional_label.barrier_rule: first-touch SL/TP on future M5 high/low; same M5 bar touching both barriers => AMBIGUOUS_DROP
directional_label.timeout_rule: if neither barrier touches by label_end_time, use last fully closed M5 close within the full horizon; incomplete end-of-dataset horizon => invalid label
directional_label.target_rule: reuse deterministic long_r/short_r edge-and-margin semantics for SELL/SKIP/BUY; this counterfactual label is not production execution-parity evidence

temporal_dependency.dependency_start_time: earliest source-bar open_time_utc required by all registered features in the selected ablation roles
temporal_dependency.execution_end_time: NULL in MTF-2 directional-only contract; later execution-label phases must define it explicitly
temporal_dependency.purge_rule: before any MTF experiment, exact timestamp intervals must reject every train sample whose dependency/label interval overlaps validation/test protected intervals; bar-count guessing is forbidden
temporal_dependency.embargo_rule: time-based authority only; no fallback to untyped max_hold_bars
temporal_dependency.implementation_phase: MTF-3 exact overlap validator is mandatory before model training

ablations.comparison_sample_authority: intersection of decision rows feature-ready for D and label-ready under one frozen geometry, so A/B/C/D compare identical decision IDs
ablations.controls: same data window, labels, protected boundaries, folds, deterministic seeds, model family and comparable search budget
ablations.stop_rule: absence of reproducible WFA/CPCV information gain blocks automatic escalation to larger DL or learned M5 timing

data_contracts.name: MTF-3 exact timestamp dependency / purge authority V1
data_contracts.mutability: Frozen V1 preregistration; semantic changes require a new contract_id/version before any MTF experiment
legal_writes: Governed MTF-3 contract transaction only; executable source must match by targeted regression test
data_contracts.retention: Git history + exact split evidence + source/data lineage
invariants: Primary fold ordering authority is M15 decision_time_utc; MTF purge never guesses chronology from a mixed-timeframe row count.
Every comparison sample exposes dependency_start_time_utc, decision_time_utc, label_end_time_utc and execution_end_time_utc.
A/B/C/D scientific comparisons use one D-common dependency interval authority so train/test decision IDs and purge decisions remain identical across role ablations.
A train sample is illegal when its exact dependency/outcome interval intersects or touches any protected validation/test outcome interval.

Current directional-only baseline may set execution_end_time_utc equal to label_end_time_utc only while MTF2 execution_label is NOT_ACTIVE_IN_MTF2; any active execution layer must provide an explicit execution end timestamp.
Untyped max_hold_bars, purge_bars or embargo_bars cannot become MTF-3 dependency authority.
CPCV remains exactly N=6,k=2 => 15 deterministic combinations; MTF-3 changes purge semantics, not the combinatorial methodology.
Existing single-TF temporal_index/research.cpcv behavior remains untouched while MTF research is OFF.

comparison_dependency_authority.rule: Use ablation D dependency_start_time_utc as the comparison dependency_start for A/B/C/D because D is the complete registered role set and A/B/C/D must share identical folds and purge decisions.

sample_interval.dependency_start_time_utc: Earliest source-bar open timestamp required by the D-complete registered feature set.
sample_interval.label_end_time_utc: Explicit post-decision directional label horizon end from MTF2 typed minutes authority.
sample_interval.execution_end_time_utc: Equal to label_end_time_utc only under the current directional-only baseline; otherwise must be explicit.

overlap_rule.pre_boundary_purge: Removes earlier train samples whose label/execution future reaches a protected decision/outcome window.
overlap_rule.post_boundary_embargo: Removes later train samples whose feature dependency reaches backward into a protected decision/outcome window.

execution_horizon_rule.future_rule: Once an ENTER/WAIT/CANCEL or other execution layer is active, explicit per-sample execution_end_time_utc is mandatory and directional-label fallback is forbidden.

cpcv.group_authority: contiguous blocks of sorted M15 decision timestamps

acceptance: Targeted MTF-3 selftest proves exact interval construction and rejects malformed/untimed dependencies.
Adversarial pre-boundary label/execution overlap and post-boundary H4-lookback overlap are both purged with exact timestamp evidence.
Every legal WFA/CPCV split audits to zero train-vs-protected outcome overlaps.
CPCV emits exactly 15 N=6,k=2 splits and each split records purged decision IDs with overlap timestamps/reason.
A/B/C/D consume identical comparison dependency authority and split decision IDs.
Existing canonical 75-gate fresh cumulative acceptance remains 75/75 FRESH_FULL; no single-TF methodology is replaced.
deferred: Model fitting, feature permutation, A/B/C/D information-gain ranking and model-family selection.
MTF Strategy Challenger, ONNX, shadow, deployment and promotion.

data_contracts.name: MTF-4 deterministic Strategy Challenger authority V1
data_contracts.mutability: Frozen V1 preregistration; semantic role or causality changes require a new contract version before implementation
legal_writes: Governed MTF-4 contract transaction before source implementation; later optimizer requests may freeze numeric ranges without changing role ownership
data_contracts.retention: Git history + exact parameter-vector lineage + MT5/Python parity + control/challenger backtest evidence
invariants: M15 is the only directional owner. H4/H1/M5 may veto but never create or reverse direction.
MTF mode evaluates one primary decision on a newly closed M15 bar; all H4/H1/M5 inputs must be fully closed at or before that M15 decision time.
Missing, stale, non-causal or unavailable required timeframe data fails closed to SKIP and cannot fall back to single-TF inside MTF mode.
M5 timing in MTF-4 is an instantaneous latest-closed-bar veto only; no ENTER/WAIT/CANCEL state machine or multi-bar timing window is introduced before MTF-7.
Existing SL/TP/MaxHold/risk authority remains unchanged and is not re-owned by H4/H1/M15/M5 role parameters.
InpUseMtfStrategy=false preserves the accepted single-TF control path.
Eligible optimization result terminates as Strategy Challenger; no automatic Strategy Champion mutation or model training is allowed.

H4.direction_source: sign(MA_fast - MA_slow) only as a context alignment veto, never as final direction

M15.authority: Existing seven-family rule_score + consensus + InpEntryThreshold/InpMinConsensus and current strategy-family weights

M5.purpose: instantaneous entry-timing veto using latest fully closed M5 bar available at M15 decision time
required_checks: one-bar body/return sign agrees with M15 direction

optimizer_integration.lifecycle: Strategy Optimizer -> eligible Strategy Challenger -> explicit Owner promotion only
optimizer_integration.ranges_authority: Numeric defaults/hard bounds must be frozen in source + optimizer acceptance before first MT5 optimization; Scientist may only narrow/shift within deterministic hard bounds.

acceptance: Genuine BEFORE plan matches every machine-extractable Python SOURCE edge; documented MQL edges are separately enforced by V204 source audit plus MetaEditor/Owner MT5 evidence.
Single-TF control with InpUseMtfStrategy=false preserves legacy decision behavior.
H4/H1/M5 are veto-only and cannot create or reverse M15 direction.
Every role snapshot is closed-bar causal at the M15 decision timestamp.
Missing any required timeframe fails closed to SKIP in MTF mode.
Exact MTF parameter-vector lineage is preserved from optimizer request through MT5 report and Strategy Challenger artifact.
MT5 and Python replay agree on deterministic MTF gate/geometry decisions for the same closed-bar inputs.
Control and MTF Challenger are backtested on identical symbol/window/cost assumptions.
No automatic Strategy Champion mutation occurs.
Fresh cumulative local acceptance remains PASS before MTF-4 closure.
deferred: A/B/C/D model training and information-gain ranking (MTF-5).
Multi-bar or learned M5 ENTER/WAIT/CANCEL timing state machine (MTF-7).

sequence_evidence_boundary.source_verified_edges: Python parity evaluator -> H4/H1/M5 gate calls.
sequence_evidence_boundary.mql_verified_by: Targeted V204 source audit plus MetaEditor compile and Owner MT5 runtime/parity acceptance.
